messages:
Priya M: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's GPU surge — want to capture owners + concrete due dates so these don't drift. Summary: autoscaler hit customer quotas, scheduler queue grew ~11m, and headroom pools were depleted in eu-west-1.
Ming C: Thanks — adding context: a few large batch inference jobs bypassed our soft-limits; quota backstop didn't trigger because the quota metric aggregation lagged ~90s.
Jon R: Agree. Root causes I see: 1) quota metric pipeline latency, 2) scheduler scoring prefers dense packing which increases tail latency during scale-ups, 3) headroom target was set to 0.8x expected traffic (too low for bursty tail).
Sasha P: Proposed action items (high level): A) add faster quota-signal (10s rollup) + alert, B) scheduler tune to prefer spare-nodes for sudden scale-ups, C) bump headroom floor + add synthetic burst tests.
Priya M: Let's assign owners and dates. I'll run the followups weekly until closed. Items: 1) quota signal pipeline (owner @Ming C) - target: 2026-04-02 23:59 UTC; 2) scheduler scoring change + experiment (owner @Jon R) - target: 2026-04-07; 3) headroom floor bump + config rollout (owner @Sasha P) - target: 2026-04-03; 4) synthetic-burst chaos test + runbook update (owner @Liam O) - target: 2026-04-08.
Ming C: Ack. For (1) I'll implement a short-path 10s aggregator and wire an alert to #eng-oncall. Plan: prototype by 2026-03-30, roll to prod 04-02.
Jon R: For (2) I'll open a draft PR with scoring weight change and a canary pipeline: sample 5% of scale-ups with spare-node preference. If tail latency improves >10% we flip. Targeting experiment start 04-04 to collect enough signals.
Sasha P: For (3) config: bump headroom floor from 0.8x to 1.1x for eu-west-1 only, monitor cost delta. I'll prepare rollout plan + rollback.
Liam O: For (4) I'll add a chaos test that injects 300 concurrent large-gen jobs and measure time-to-recover. Will also add steps to runbook for ops to force temporary headroom increase.
Priya M: Two smaller cross-cutting items: X) update customer-facing SLA doc with expected degraded behavior during quota backstop triggers (owner @Priya M) - due 2026-04-05; Y) postmortem followup sync weekly on Tue 10:30am PT until all items closed (owner @Priya M).
Jon R: One risk note — increasing headroom increases cost; we'll add a cost/impact tracker row in the rollout PR.
Ming C: I'll add instrumentation: a histogram of quota-aggregation-latency and an alert if p95 > 60s.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INF-2026-2287. Linked to this thread.
Priya M: Ok — I'll collect checkpoints. Quick checklist I want in each PR: motivation, small perf test, cost estimate, rollback steps, and owner + ETA in PR description. Please tag me in PRs. :thumbsup:
Sasha P: Tagged. Creating the headroom PR now and will include a canary by region config.
Liam O: Will add the chaos job to the daily test harness and mark as non-blocking for CI.
Priya M: Thanks team — I'll post an interim status on Tue next week. If anything slips, flag here asap. :eyes:
